entries.name: Berserker
entries.why: Attacks hit every enemy while Frenzied, with lifesteal. Best tower sustain and area damage.

entries.name: Pyromancer
entries.why: Burn on every enemy every turn, then Detonate. Area damage with no crits needed.

entries.name: Marksman
entries.why: Volley hits every enemy every turn with no cooldown.

entries.name: Zealot
entries.why: Level 40+. Area Brand, extra actions and a self-healing ultra.

entries.name: Seraph
entries.why: Level 40+. Area damage plus full-party heals and revives.

entries.name: Dragoon
entries.why: Reliable Sunder triggers for Rupture on every enemy. No built-in lifesteal.

entries.name: Gunner
entries.why: Scattershot Burns every enemy. Strong but costs HP.

entries.name: Assassin
entries.why: Best at stacking Bleed. Area damage needs gems, and lifesteal comes from gear.

entries.name: Sellsword
entries.why: Best single-target Rupture: guaranteed crit every turn, about 1.7x damage. Weak in groups.

entries.name: Jester
entries.why: Mockery hits every enemy and makes them Vulnerable. Low damage on its own.

entries.name: Ranger
entries.why: Hawk adds Bleed and Vulnerable by itself. Small numbers.

entries.name: Gladiator
entries.why: Favor gives crits and damage. One target at a time.

entries.name: Skald
entries.why: Strong party buffs (Keen, Haste). Little damage alone.

entries.name: Oracle
entries.why: Undoes damage and revives. Support first.

entries.name: Druid
entries.why: Single-target Poison and Regen.

entries.name: Priest
entries.why: Healer. Take it only to reach the ultra classes at level 40.

entries.name: Outlaw
entries.why: Blind and buff stealing. Little damage.

entries.name: Duelist
entries.why: Strong one-on-one, poor against groups.

entries.name: Knight
entries.why: Protects allies.

entries.name: Herald
entries.why: Gives allies extra actions.

entries.name: Sentinel
entries.why: Defensive support.
